messages:
maria-ops: Heads up — noticed ~1.2% of billing events are missing provenance in the daily recon. Failures spike after cross-region deploy yesterday :eyes:
jonah-platform: ugh. any repro or pattern? what window are we seeing late arrivals?
maria-ops: mostly events with ts older than 18h arriving after finalization; shard replays show events with missing token_fingerprint. sample payloads attached to the ticket.
kevin-ml: could be our tokenizer/ingest sidecar dropping provenance when the request is split. saw similar in staging earlier.
sara-sre: audit-bot reported consumer lag on ingest-stream ~ 5-7 mins at peak, not 18h though. doesn't fully explain it.
audIT-bot: job billing-reconciler-run #202 failed: 503 ingest-proxy timeout (retrying)
(edited to correct job id)
maria-ops: root cause maybe twofold: (1) late replay from tenant-side retries, (2) provenance pointer not persisted when chunked requests are compacted.
jonah-platform: short-term fix ideas?
kevin-ml: short term: materialize a lightweight provenance index (tenant, request_root_id, fingerprint) as soon as we accept request. make it write-through memtable so it's cheap. SQL:
```
CREATE TABLE metering.provenance_index (
  tenant_id TEXT,
  root_id TEXT,
  fingerprint TEXT,
  first_seen_ts BIGINT,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, root_id)
);
```
This lets reconciliation join on root_id instead of relying on envelope enrichment later.
maria-ops: that plus extending finalizer window from 24h -> 36h for 2 weeks while we monitor?
jonah-platform: tradeoff is cost and retention. materialized index increases writes per request, need to measure tail latency impact.
sara-sre: agree. let's gate by default to Dedicated customers first (lower QPS). monitor p95 latency and write error rate.
kevin-ml: long-term: refactor ingestion handshake — split "payload acceptance" from "provenance enrichment". Acceptance returns ack and stores a min envelope; enrichment is async idempotent. That removes coupling to chunked compaction.
maria-ops: sounds like the RFC we discussed but narrower. Jonah, should we open a follow-up RFC for the acceptance+enrichment split?
jonah-platform: yes. I'll spin up a short RFC with options: A) light provenance index + extend finalizer window B) acceptance+enrichment refactor (bigger lift) C) dedupe stamps + bloom filter for late-arrivals. Include rollback plan and telemetry.
kevin-ml: also consider storing a small hash in the compacted chunk header so compaction preserves provenance pointer even when payloads merge. cheap and minimal change.
maria-ops: good idea. Implementation checklist for short-term patch:
- [ ] create provenance_index table + migration script
- [ ] instrument write latency p50/p95
- [ ] gate by customer_tier (dedicated opt-in)
- [ ] extend finalizer window + flag to revert
- [ ] add quick-run reconciliation job to backfill missing pointers
jonah-platform: assigning owners: kevin for index, sara for SLO checks, maria for recon job and rollout plan.
sara-sre: I'll add a dashboard and alert for 'provenance-miss-rate' and a paging threshold at 0.2%.
maria-ops: timeframe? can we ship short term in 2 weeks?
kevin-ml: doable for index + gating, but backfill may take longer.
jonah-platform: okay, create RFC draft by EOD tomorrow, include benchmarks and cost estimate.
maria-ops: thanks :thumbsup:
kevin-ml: pinging infra: @infra to make sure migration won't impact compaction jobs
infra: noted. will review migration plan and propose low-QPS rollout strategy :ok_hand:
jonah-platform: great. follow-ups: link RFC here when ready and tag owners. Will mark this thread as action-item.
_meta: generated for dataset: provenance index / staleness fix followup
